verdict.rationale: Fivetran publishes a usage-based pricing model with defined tiers and Monthly Active Rows (MAR) as the metering unit, which sounds estimable in advance, but multiple independent hands-on reports describe billing as unpredictable, subject to sudden spikes, and even inflated by join-based row counting that customers didn't request — directly contradicting the claim that costs can be reliably estimated before connecting a source. missing for 10: any first-party cost calculator/estimator tool, and resolution of the row-inflation/spike complaints raised by users.
